design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated to either enriched E-EPA supplementation or placebo using computer-generated stratified randomization lists.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was computer-generated, concealed via the hospital pharmacy dispensing numbered bottles, and baseline differences were minimal and consistent with chance.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Stratified randomization lists were computer-generated by a statistician and given to the hospital’s pharmacy. The researchers were responsible for seeing participants allocated the next available entry number into the trial, and each woman received her capsules directly from the pharmacist.

domain_judgments.rationale: Participants and investigators were successfully blinded using matching placebo capsules, blinding assessment showed no significant difference in guessing allocation, and the analysis was intention-to-treat.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Subjects, investigators, and staff were blinded to treatment assignment unti the last participants completed the study. Each 500-mg OM3 capsule (Isodis Natura, Brussels, Belgium) contained 350 mg EPA and 50 mg DHA in the form of ethyl esters. To assist with blinding, 0.2% of regular fish oil (18% EPA/12% DHA) wa added to the placebo for better matching of possible fish-oil taste.

domain_judgments.rationale: Attrition was low overall (88.3% completed week 8), reasons were documented, and sensitivity analysis using last-observation-carried-forward did not change the results.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Of the 120 women with PD randomly assigned, 108 (90.0%) completed the 4-wk follow-up, and 106 (88.3%) completed the 8-wk follow-up (Figure 1). Although not significant, a higher proportion of women in the placebo group than in the E-EPA group did not complete the 4-wk (14.8% compared with 5.1%; P ¼ 0.0775) and 8-wk (16.4% compared with 6.8%; P ¼ 0.1010) follow-up.

domain_judgments.rationale: Validated assessment instruments were used with trained, blinded assessors for clinician ratings, and self-report scales were assessed identically between double-blinded groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Subjects, investigators, and staff were blinded to treatment assignment unti the last participants completed the study. Initial and final psychiatric assessments included the Mini International Neuropsychiatric Interview (version 5.0.0), the HAM-D-21, and the Clinical Global Impression Severity Scale (CGS). Assessor psychiatrists underwent standard ized training before the study began.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although the trial was pre-registered (ISRCTN69617477), the overall trial failed to show significant differences on primary or secondary outcomes, and positive findings were emphasized based on post-hoc subgroup/stratification analyses by baseline MDE status.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Stratification analyses for MDE diagnosis at baseline indicated that differences in adjusted 8-wk changes between the E-EPA group without MDE (n ¼ 46) and the placebo group (n ¼ 45) were 8.0 (95% CI: 0.6, 15.3; P ¼ 0.034) for the PGWB, 20.2 (95% CI: 20.01, 20.4; P ¼ 0.040) for the HSCL-D-20, and 22.7 (95% CI: 20.3, 25.1; P ¼ 0.030) for the HAM-D-21.

overall_summary: The study was a well-conducted double-blind randomized controlled trial with low risk of bias in randomization, intervention deviations, missing data, and outcome measurement. However, there are some concerns regarding selection of reported results due to the prominence given to subgroup stratification analyses after the primary overall analyses failed to reach statistical significance.

design_rationale: The study is described as a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled pilot study where patients were stratified according to antidepressant use and then randomly allocated to receive fish oil or mineral oil placebo.
overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is judged as 'some concerns' due to insufficient reporting of the specific sequence generation and allocation concealment methods, along with the absence of a pre-registered statistical analysis plan.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated to either n-3 PUFAs or placebo using a computer-generated block randomization scheme prepared by an independent statistician.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was computer-generated, concealed using sequentially numbered opaque envelopes, and baseline differences between groups were generally consistent with chance.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: An independent, study-blinded statistician prepared a computer-generated randomization scheme allowing for randomization in blocks. Sequentially numbered containers with either n-3 PUFAs or placebo were randomly assigned to patients. Identity codes were concealed in sequentially numbered opaque envelopes managed by the study investigators.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was double-blinded with an identical-appearing placebo, and an intention-to-treat analysis approach was implemented without notable trial-context deviations affecting the outcomes.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: All study personnel and patients remained blinded to the identity codes throughout the course of the study... Patients were randomly divided into two groups taking three capsules a day of either n-3 PUFAs... or a placebo containing safflower oil with oleic acid...

domain_judgments.rationale: Substantial attrition occurred (nearly 30% did not complete), and the analysis excluded participants who lacked post-baseline measurements while relying on last-observation-carried-forward (LOCF) for the rest, introducing a high risk of bias due to missing outcome data.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Thirty-five patients were enrolled and randomized to either n-3 PUFA (n = 18) or placebo (n = 17) treatment groups, but only 24 patients (12 in each group; 66.7 vs. 70.6%, p = 0.083) completed this trial per protocol (fig. 1)... Values are the mean ± SE from patients (n = 12 in the n-3 PUFA group and n = 13 in the placebo group) with intention-to-treat with last-observation-carried-forward who completed the CES-D-K questionnaire at baseline and had at least one valid CES-D-K post-baseline data point.

domain_judgments.rationale: The outcome assessors and participants were blinded to the intervention allocation, and standard, validated psychiatric scales were used.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The Center for Epidemiological Studies Depression Scale Korean version (CES-D-K), Hamilton Depression Rating Scale 17-item version (HAM-D-17), Clinical Global Impression Scale (CGI-S), and Clinical Global Impression Improvement (CGI-I) scores were measured by a psychiatrist who was blinded to treatment groups.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although the trial was prospectively registered, the primary outcome analysis emphasized covariate-adjusted models (adjusting for dietary variables), and detailed pre-specified analysis plan details are not fully reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This study was registered with the Clinical Research Information Service (KCT0001206)... For primary analysis to determine the supplemental efficacy of n-3 PUFAs on depression, we evaluated the changes in CES-D-K scores... after adjusting for energy, fat, and fish intake as covariates.

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is high due to substantial participant attrition (roughly 30% dropout) and the use of modified intention-to-treat with last-observation-carried-forward (LOCF) excluding participants without post-baseline measurements. Additional concerns exist regarding selection of reported results due to covariate-adjusted model reporting.

design_rationale: The study is described as a double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized clinical trial where participants were assigned to intervention or placebo using a block randomization table prepared by an independent statistician.

domain_judgments.rationale: Randomization sequence generation was performed using block randomization prepared by an independent statistician, allocation was concealed through coded identical bottles and sequential participant numbering, and baseline characteristics were comparable between groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Bottles of identical oily preparation for each treatment group were assigned a participant number according to a coded (AB) block randomization table, prepared by an independent statistician. Investigators were blinded to the randomization table, the code assignments, and the procedure. As participants were enrolled, they were assigned a progressive participant number.

domain_judgments.rationale: Double-blinding was successfully maintained with identical presentation and lemon flavor matching, no important deviations from the intended protocol were reported, and all randomized participants were analyzed in the groups to which they were assigned.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The control group was treated with a placebo made of paraffin oil with the same lemon flavor as the intervention product... None of the studied patients complained of fish smell or fish eructation or made any comment about the content of the supplement she was taking or about the perception of having been included in 1 of the 2 groups, thus indicating the concealment of treatment allocation.

domain_judgments.rationale: All 46 randomized participants (22 in the n-3 group and 24 in the placebo group) completed the 8-week intervention and were included in the outcome analysis without any dropouts or missing data.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The diagram includes the number of patients analyzed for the main outcome (effect on depressed mood)... n-3 group (n = 22) ... placebo group (n = 24).

domain_judgments.rationale: Depressive symptoms were evaluated using the validated Geriatric Depression Scale (GDS) and health-related quality of life with SF-36, applied identically across groups by assessors and participants blinded to treatment assignment.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary endpoint was the improvement of depressive symptoms, as evaluated by the Geriatric Depression Scale (GDS)... Investigators were blinded to the randomization table, the code assignments, and the procedure.

domain_judgments.rationale: No prospectively registered clinical trial protocol or pre-specified statistical analysis plan is referenced, raising some concerns regarding potential selective reporting of specific analyses or secondary outcomes.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Primary Endpoint. The effect of n-3 LCPUFA supplementation on depressed mood, assessed by comparing the adjusted posttreatment means of the GDS total score in the n-3 and placebo groups, was considered the main outcome measure. Secondary Endpoint. The secondary endpoints, addressed by comparing the adjusted posttreatment means of the n-3 and placebo groups, were the effect of n-3 LCPUFA supplementation on (1) health-related quality of life, evaluated with SF-36...

overall_summary: The trial was well conducted with robust randomization, effective blinding, and complete outcome data for all participants, but lacks reference to a prospective trial registration or pre-published analysis plan, leading to an overall judgment of some concerns.

design_rationale: The study is described as a randomized controlled trial in which participants were randomly allocated in a 1:1 ratio using a computer-generated block randomization code.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was computer-generated, concealed via consecutively prepackaged kits administered in order, and baseline differences were minor and adjusted for in statistical models.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A block randomization code was independently computer generated at Sunnybrook Health Science Centre pharmacy. Kits with study medication were consecutively prepackaged as per the randomization sequence before commencement of the trial and were administered in order by trained study personnel. All study personnel remained blind to treatment allocation until the database was 'locked.'

domain_judgments.rationale: Double-blind design with matched placebo capsules was maintained, adherence was monitored, and an intention-to-treat analysis was performed.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The n-3 PUFA and placebo capsules were similar in appearance (dark brown) and taste (lemon-lime flavoring)... All study personnel remained blind to treatment allocation until the database was 'locked.'... An intention to treat (ITT) analysis of treatment efficacy was conducted using a repeated measures general linear regression... Missing data from week 4, 8, and/or 12 assessments were imputed using a multiple imputation procedure...

domain_judgments.rationale: Dropout rates were low (11%), balanced between groups, reasons were reported, and missing data were appropriately imputed for the ITT analysis.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Eighty-two (89%) of the randomized patients completed the trial. The dropout rate in the n-3 PUFA arm (n = 5) did not differ from that in the placebo arm (n = 5)... Missing data from week 4, 8, and/or 12 assessments were imputed using a multiple imputation procedure (5 imputed data sets, as per Rubin).

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcomes were measured using standard, validated instruments (HAM-D, BDI-II, standardized cognitive battery) by blinded assessors across both study arms.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Study outcomes were assessed at baseline and at weeks 4, 8, and 12... All cognitive testing was performed at a standardized time (900 hours ± 30 minutes)... All study personnel remained blind to treatment allocation until the database was 'locked.'

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was registered on clinicaltrials.gov (NCT00981383), primary (HAM-D) and secondary (BDI-II) outcomes were clearly pre-specified, and results are reported fully and consistently with the trial protocol.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The CAD Randomized Omega-3 Trial in Depression was an RCT investigating the antidepressant efficacy of 1.9-g/d n-3 PUFA treatment compared with placebo using a 12-week parallel arm design in which patients were randomized in a 1:1 ratio... The clinical trial identifier (clinicaltrials.gov) is NCT00981383.

overall_summary: This well-conducted double-blind randomized controlled trial employed robust randomization sequence generation and allocation concealment, effective blinding, low and balanced attrition with multiple imputation ITT analyses, standardized outcome measures, and pre-registered protocol adherence, resulting in an overall low risk of bias.

design_rationale: The study is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical trial with computer-generated block randomization managed by an external statistician and study pharmacist.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was computer-generated, concealed via central pharmacy dispensing, and baseline characteristics were balanced across groups.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The randomization schedule was generated separately for each site in blocks of 12 using 'proc plan' in SAS. This schedule was generated by an external statistician who was not involved with the OCEAN study and sent directly to the study pharmacist without involvement of the OCEAN study statistician.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was double-blind with identical matching placebo capsules, and the primary analysis followed the intention-to-treat principle with appropriate multiple imputation.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The placebo (corn oil) and omega-3 capsules were identical in color and smell... These analyses were conducted under the intention-to-treat principle in which the missing primary endpoints were imputed by using multiple imputations in SAS PROC MI.

domain_judgments.rationale: Attrition was low (7.4% overall, balanced across groups), reasons were documented, and missing data for the intention-to-treat analysis of primary outcomes were handled using multiple imputation.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Eight participants terminated the trial early: 3 in the 2:1 EPA/DHA group, 1 in the high EPA group, and 4 in the placebo group... These analyses were conducted under the intention-to-treat principle in which the missing primary endpoints were imputed by using multiple imputations in SAS PROC MI.

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome assessors and participants were blinded to treatment allocation using identical placebo capsules, and standard objective and clinical assessment methods were used.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary endpoints of this study, analyzed by using the intention-to-treat principle, were depressive symptoms measured according to the HAM-D and red blood cell (RBC) levels of EPA... Gas chromatography was performed by using a GC2010 Gas Chromatograph... The placebo (corn oil) and omega-3 capsules were identical in color and smell.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered (NCT02057406) and results for all specified primary and secondary outcomes are reported in accordance with the pre-specified protocol.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The primary endpoints of this study, analyzed by using the intention-to-treat principle, were depressive symptoms measured according to the HAM-D and red blood cell (RBC) levels of EPA... (Omega-3 Supplementation for Co-Morbid Depression and Heart Failure Treatment [OCEAN]; NCT02057406)

overall_summary: The study was judged to be at low risk of bias across all five RoB 2 domains due to robust randomization and allocation concealment, successful blinding with matched placebo, minimal and balanced attrition handled by multiple imputation, and pre-specified outcome reporting.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned to receive either DHA (2 g/day) or placebo for 6 weeks in a double-blind, randomized controlled trial.

domain_judgments.rationale: The method of random sequence generation and allocation concealment is not described, and baseline imbalances were present (e.g., baseline HDRS score differed significantly: 23.5 vs 28.5, p=0.001; weight and smoking also differed).
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The participants were randomly assigned to receive either 2 g/day of DHA or placebo for 6 weeks. ... The randomization produced some baseline differences between the two groups.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although the study is described as double-blind, 14 of 18 DHA participants reported a 'fish' aftertaste compared to none in the placebo group, which could have compromised blinding to the intervention.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: We report the results of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial ... The reported adverse events in the DHA group included a “fish” aftertaste (N=14)

domain_judgments.rationale: Outcome data were available for 35 of 36 randomized participants (97.2%), making the risk of bias from missing outcome data very low.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Of the 36 participants who enrolled, 35 had at least one follow-up assessment and were included in this intent-to-treat analysis.

domain_judgments.rationale: Depression rating scales involve subjective assessment, and blinding of outcome assessors may have been compromised by distinct intervention-related adverse events such as the fish aftertaste in the DHA group.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale was the a priori primary outcome measure, and response was defined as a 50% or greater reduction in score from baseline to study endpoint.

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary outcome and definition of response were specified a priori, and results for continuous change and dichotomous response on MADRS, HDRS, and CGI are fully reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The Montgomery-Åsberg Depression Rating Scale was the a priori primary outcome measure, and response was defined as a 50% or greater reduction in score from baseline to study endpoint.

overall_summary: The overall risk of bias is judged as some concerns due to lack of reporting on sequence generation and allocation concealment alongside notable baseline differences, as well as potential unblinding arising from a fish aftertaste reported exclusively by participants in the DHA arm.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly allocated to one of three treatment arms (EPA-enriched, DHA-enriched, or placebo) using blocked randomization procedures coordinated by institutional research pharmacies.

domain_judgments.rationale: The allocation sequence was generated via blocked randomization by research pharmacies and concealed using blinded treatment codes, with no baseline differences between groups beyond chance.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Randomization and treatment assignment were carried out by the research pharmacies of both institutions by standard allocation procedures and a fixed block size of 30 subjects (MGH) or a randomly permuted block size between 6 and 15 subjects (CSMC). Only blind treatment codes, coordinated between both site pharmacies, were noted on randomization lists provided to study staff.

domain_judgments.rationale: A double-blind, double-dummy placebo design was maintained successfully with identical placebo controls, and mixed-model repeated measures analysis was conducted on all evaluable randomized participants who received intervention.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A double-dummy placebo design was used to maintain the blind, since DHA-enriched capsules differed in appearance from EPA-enriched capsules. Each patient took capsules from 2 bottles, with one containing either DHA-enriched or DHA-placebo and the other containing either EPA-enriched or EPA-placebo, depending on randomization.

domain_judgments.rationale: Study completion was high (87% of evaluable participants, 154/196 randomized) with balanced dropouts across treatment arms, and repeated-measures mixed modeling handled missing follow-up data without indication of bias.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Nineteen subjects dropped out before completing at least 1 postbaseline visit, leaving 177 evaluable subjects... Eighty-seven percent of 177 evaluable subjects completed the study.

domain_judgments.rationale: Standardized, validated depression rating scales were used, and both clinical assessors and participants remained blinded to treatment assignment throughout.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Only blind treatment codes, coordinated between both site pharmacies, were noted on randomization lists provided to study staff. All study staff and participants remained blind to treatment assignment... Analyses of primary and secondary measures of depression severity were carried out based on blind treatment codes.

domain_judgments.rationale: The trial was prospectively registered (NCT00517036), and all prespecified primary and secondary outcomes were reported according to a standard pre-established statistical plan.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT00517036... Clinical outcome measures at every study visit included HDRS-17 score (primary outcome measure), CGI-S and CGI-I scores, 16-item Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology–Self-Report (QIDS-SR-16) scores...

overall_summary: This was a well-designed, prospective, double-blind, double-dummy randomized controlled trial with pharmacy-controlled allocation concealment, high retention, appropriate handling of missing data via MMRM, and low risk of reporting bias. All five RoB 2 domains were assessed as having low risk of bias.

design_rationale: Participants were randomly assigned to the omega-3 or placebo groups using a permuted block randomization procedure.

domain_judgments.rationale: Although permuted block randomization was used and baseline characteristics were reasonably balanced, allocation concealment is not reported.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Randomization was carried out using the permuted block randomization procedure. Patients were randomly assigned into omega-3 or placebo groups.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was described as single-blind with placebo capsules lacking fish odor which the authors note may compromise blinding, and analysis excluded 9 randomized participants (a per-protocol/complete-case analysis rather than true intention-to-treat).
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: This study was a randomized, single-blind, placebo-controlled trial... Both placebo and omega-3 soft-gel capsules were identical in size, shape, color, and packaging... Thus, 45 patients (25 in the omega-3 group and 20 in the placebo group) completed the study and were included in final analysis.

domain_judgments.rationale: Nine of 54 randomized patients (16.7%) dropped out and were excluded from the analysis without imputation or sensitivity analyses to examine potential bias from missingness.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: A total of nine patients failed to complete the study period. The reasons for patients’ exclusion are presented in Fig. 1. Thus, 45 patients (25 in the omega-3 group and 20 in the placebo group) completed the study and were included in final analysis.

domain_judgments.rationale: The primary outcome (BDI) is self-reported and the trial was single-blind with placebo capsules lacking fish oil odor, meaning participant awareness of assignment could have influenced reported depressive symptoms.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: Fifth, placebo capsules lacked omega-3 capsule odor that may affect the blindness of patients in the placebo arm of the study... The BDI is a 21-item, self-report questionnaire measuring characteristic symptoms of depression.

domain_judgments.rationale: The study was prospectively registered (IRCT201202203043N5) and reports the predefined primary and secondary clinical and laboratory outcomes according to plan without obvious selective reporting.
domain_judgments.evidence_quote: The study protocol was approved by the local ethics committee of Tehran University of Medical Sciences and registered in Iranian Registry of Clinical Trials (registry number: IRCT201202203043N5).

overall_summary: The trial is judged as having some concerns overall due to missing details on allocation concealment, potential unblinding of a self-reported outcome (single-blind design with lack of fish odor in the placebo), and complete-case analysis following attrition of ~17% of participants.
